title: Two Kinds Of With
label: ch:ml-with
canDo: I can say who came along with me and what I did something with, and I know those are different relationships in Malayalam.

payoff.summary: From cold: both company words and their register split, the instrument ending, and the question English never makes a speaker ask.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. The company words reuse the genitive-plus-postposition slot the place-words chapter established, and the instrument ending is one the learner already owns from the conditional -- the chapter's point is that the host decides the reading.
